import os,glob,re
def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def feats(I,O):
    I=np.array(I); O=np.array(O)
    bg,objs=get_objs(I); L=find_L(objs)
    corner=[p for p in L if any((p[0]+d,p[1]) in L for d in (1,-1)) and any((p[0],p[1]+d) in L for d in (1,-1))][0]
    cr,ccx=corner
    vt=min(p for p in L if p[1]==ccx); ht=max(p for p in L if p[0]==cr)
    H,W=I.shape
    rows=[]
    for col,c in objs:
        changed=any(O[r,x]!=col for r,x in c)
        rs=[r for r,_ in c]; cs=[x for _,x in c]
        mind=lambda p: min(abs(r-p[0])+abs(x-p[1]) for r,x in c)
        rows.append(dict(color=col,n=len(c),r0=min(rs),r1=max(rs),c0=min(cs),c1=max(cs),
            d_corner=mind((cr,ccx)), d_vtip=mind(vt), d_htip=mind(ht),

            toBL=min((H-1-r)+x for r,x in c), toBR=min((H-1-r)+(W-1-x) for r,x in c),
            toTL=r+x for r,x in [min(c,key=lambda p:p[0]+p[1])], 
            changed=changed, bg=bg))
    return rows

def canon(cs):
    cs=sorted(cs); pts=[(r-min(p[0] for p in cs),c-min(p[1] for p in cs)) for r,c in cs]
    variants=set()
    for k in range(4):
        for sg in (1,-1):
            v=[(sg*r,sg*c) if k%2==0 else (sg*c,sg*r) for r,c in pts]
            v2=sorted((r-min(x[0] for x in v),c-min(x[1] for x in v)) for r,c in v)
            variants.add(tuple(v2))
    return min(variants)
def enclosure(r_):
    c,v,h=r_['corner'],r_['vt'],r_['ht']
    return set((rr,cc) for rr in range(min(c[0],v[0]),max(c[0],v[0])+1) for cc in range(min(c[1],h[1]),max(c[1],h[1])+1))
ok=True
for nm in names:
    r_=res[nm]; R=enclosure(r_); H,W=r_['I'].shape
    capt=[(col,cs) for col,cs in r_['objs'] if set(cs)<=R and set(cs)!=r_['L']]
    chg=[(col,cs) for col,cs,ch in r_['oo'] if ch]
    print(nm,'captives:',[(c,len(s)) for c,s in capt],'changed:',[(c,len(s)) for c,s in chg])
    assert len(capt)==1 and len(chg)==1
    cc_,cs_=capt[0]; tc,ts=chg[0]
    match = canon(cs_)==canon(ts)
    print('  shape match (dihedral):',match)
    ok&=match

def findL(objs):
    best=None
    for col,cs in objs:
        rs=Counter(p[0] for p in cs); cls=Counter(p[1] for p in cs)
        mr,mc=rs.most_common(1)[0][1],cls.most_common(1)[0][1]
        if mr>=3 and mc>=3 and mr+mc>=len(cs)+1 and len(cs)>=6:
            if best is None or len(cs)>len(best[1]): best=(col,cs)
    col,cs=best; Ls=set(cs)
    vc=Counter(p[1] for p in cs).most_common(1)[0][0]; hr=Counter(p[0] for p in cs).most_common(1)[0][0]
    corner=(hr,vc)
    vtc=[p for p in cs if p[1]==vc]; vt=vtc[0] if vtc[0][0]<corner[0] else vtc[-1]
    htc=[p for p in cs if p[0]==hr]; ht=htc[0] if htc[0][1]<corner[1] else htc[-1]
    return col,cs,Ls,corner,vt,ht
def solve_final(I):
    I=np.array(I); bg,objs=get_objs2(I)
    Lcol,Lc,Ls,corner,vt,ht=findL(objs)
    R=set((r,c) for r in range(min(corner[0],vt[0]),max(corner[0],vt[0])+1) for c in range(min(corner[1],ht[1]),max(corner[1],ht[1])+1))
    caps=[(col,cs) for col,cs in objs if set(cs)<=R and set(cs)!=Ls]
    assert len(caps)==1,(corner,[(c,len(s)) for c,s in caps])
    twin=[(col,cs) for col,cs in objs if (col,cs)!=caps[0] and canon(cs)==canon(caps[0][1])]
    assert len(twin)==1
    O=I.copy()
    for r,c in twin[0][1]: O[r,c]=Lcol
    return O
